from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    w=lambda n,t: open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
    w('a.conf','x=1\n@include b.conf\n'); w('b.conf','@include a.conf\n'); w('c.conf','@include nope\n')
    w('s.conf','@include s.conf\n'); os.mkdir(os.path.join(d,'sub'))

    w('top.conf','x=1\n@include sub/n.conf\ny=5\n')
    for f in ('a.conf','c.conf','s.conf'):
        try: load(os.path.join(d,f))
        except ConfigError as e: print('ok',e)
    c=load(os.path.join(d,'top.conf')); print(c.get('x'),c.get('y'),c.get('z'))
